metadata.coverage_limitations: Only Leak-Lookup was queried without API key. HIBP/Snusbase/DeHashed would significantly expand coverage.

breached_accounts.interpretation: 1Win is a Russian sports betting/gambling platform. The Nov 2024 breach affected ~95M records globally. Exposed PII includes DOB (can be used to reset passwords), phone (for SMS phishing/SIM swap), IP (geolocation), country (BR — confirms target), name (full name), id (unique identifier on platform). HIGH PROBABILITY of password reuse between this gambling account and corporate accounts (Gmail, GWS, Tutory, WP-admin, Supabase).
attack_vectors: Credential stuffing on Gmail (password reuse check)
Spear phishing using DOB + phone + name (highly personalized)
Account takeover via 'forgot password' + DOB verification
SMS phishing using leaked phone number
SIM swap attempt using leaked phone + DOB
recommended_immediate_actions: Validate password reuse on personal Gmail account
Validate password reuse on GWS accounts (contato@pmminas.com, otavio@pmminas.com, admin@pmminas.com)
Validate password reuse on Tutory login (mentoria.metodooba.com.br/login.php)
Validate password reuse on Supabase auth (nnvdfnuopgtrjzfburub.supabase.co/auth/v1)
Use leaked PII for spear phishing pretexts (e.g., 'Confirm your 1Win account Otávio...')

next_steps_for_coverage: Monitor future breaches for these emails
